description: This file defines a class 'MultiSearchReplaceDiffStrategy' implementing a diff strategy for precise, targeted content replacements in files, supporting fuzzy matching, line number handling, and complex diff parsing.

classes.name: MultiSearchReplaceDiffStrategy
classes.description: A class implementing a diff strategy for precise, targeted search-and-replace operations with fuzzy matching and diff parsing.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the diff strategy.

methods.name: getToolDescription
methods.description: Provides a detailed description of the diff tool's purpose and usage.

methods.name: unescapeMarkers
methods.description: Replaces escaped diff markers with their unescaped versions.

methods.name: validateMarkerSequencing
methods.description: Validates the correct sequencing and structure of diff markers in the diff content.

methods.name: applyDiff
methods.description: Parses the diff content, performs fuzzy matching, and applies targeted replacements to the original content.

methods.name: getProgressStatus
methods.description: Provides progress status during diff application, including partial progress and failure counts.
